speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are an 8-month-old boy experiencing feeding difficulties and abdominal distension. To understand what is going on, can you tell me when these symptoms started and if you have been vomiting, especially if it looks like green bile?

speaker: Patient
text: The baby has been very fussy, feeding less than usual, and the abdomen looks distended. Crying gets worse when the belly is touched.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you. The tenderness on palpation suggests an acute issue. Have you noticed any blood or mucus in the stool, or has your baby passed a ribbon-like (thin, stringy) stool recently? REQUEST TEST: Stool_Occult_Blood

speaker: Patient
text: There has not been fever, vomiting, or diarrhea like a stomach infection. The baby was born at 39 weeks without birth complications. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Intussusception and told me the presentation was already quite typical.
